name: Rangaraj R
text: As a father, seeing my son reduce his weight from 77.3 kgs to 70.5 kgs while his SGPT, SGOT, and triglyceride levels all improved significantly was beyond satisfying. What I appreciated most was that it never felt extreme. Thank you, Dt. Drashti Zatakia, for guiding him so patiently.

name: Vidula Karhadkar
text: I had an excellent experience working with Drashti. From understanding my lifestyle, preferences, and health goals, her guidance was practical, easy to follow, and tailored specifically to me. Thanks to her expertise, I've seen real improvements in my energy levels, eating habits, and overall well-being.

name: Parth Trivedi
text: Full marks to Drashti's knowledge which she applies into the real world. She helped me get back in shape and overcome cholesterol levels and a pre-diabetic condition. I came down to 72kg from 87kg within 3 months, and have maintained it since. Give your health another shot — the best help you can get is from Drashti.

name: Krishna Patel
text:
I started consulting Dt. Drashti mainly for my gut health issues, constipation and low energy levels, previous liver issues. It's been around 6 months now, and I've seen a really good difference in my digestion, stamina and overall health.

The diet plans were easy to follow, with lots of food options and yummy recipes. I never felt like I was following a strict diet. She also helped me become more regular with my workouts and daily routine. My recent blood reports have improved too, which makes me really happy!

One thing I really want to mention is how comfortable I've always felt talking to her. I could openly share things with her without feeling judged or hesitant. It never felt like a very formal dietitian-client relationship. We bonded really well, and that made the whole journey even better for me.

I'm genuinely happy with my progress and really glad I chose Health Streak. Thank you, Drashti!❤️❤️
